record_stage_scope: Only metadata with model/report/profile and referenced contents already produced. PARTIAL/EVALUATOR_ERROR refers to a later-stage partial evaluation, not preconstruction failure. Preconstruction lifecycle records require a separate future schema; never fabricate digests.
source_identity: source_snapshot_digest is SHA256 of source manifest/bundle, NOT Git commit SHA. No Git revision field or code-version authentication is implemented.
